findings.problem: Global pairwise disjointness is stronger than the construction requires. The two collars only need a and b to lie strictly outside every disk other than their respective designated disk. Consequently, the statement unnecessarily excludes overlapping obstacles away from those endpoints.
findings.proposed_change:
Provide the following general formulation, optionally retaining the current theorem as a corollary:

theorem exterior_arc_polygonal_replacement {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (z : ι → Plane) (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (k l : ι) (a b : Plane) (hab : a ≠ b)
    (ha : squaredLength (a-z k)=r^2) (hb : squaredLength (b-z l)=r^2)
    (ha_sep : ∀ i, i ≠ k → r^2 < squaredLength (a-z i))
    (hb_sep : ∀ i, i ≠ l → r^2 < squaredLength (b-z i))
    (γ : Path a b) (U : Set Plane) (hU : IsOpen U) (hγU : ∀ t, γ t ∈ U)
    (hγout : ∀ t, t ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : unitInterval) 1 → γ t ∈ outsideDisks z r) :
    ∃ P : PolygonalChain U a b, Function.Injective P.path ∧
      (∀ t, t ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : unitInterval) 1 → P.path t ∈ outsideDisks z r)

Factor a variant of exists_finite_disk_collar taking `(hsep : ∀ j, j ≠ k → r^2 < squaredLength (x-z j))`. Its existing proof works with hxV replaced by `⟨hxu, Set.mem_iInter.mpr (fun j => hsep j.val j.property)⟩`; the open finite intersection, exists_radial_tip_collar application, and subsequent subset arguments are unchanged. Apply that variant at both endpoints; the remainder of the target proof is unchanged. The old hd supplies these local inequalities by disjointness and ha/hb. Keep hr and hab: this does not assert the zero-radius or coincident-endpoint cases. The case k = l remains allowed, while endpoints touching another indexed disk remain excluded.
findings.benefit: Users can polygonally replace paths outside finite unions of overlapping disks whenever the endpoints are exposed on their designated circles, without proving irrelevant separation between entire disks.

def outsideDisks {ι : Type*} (z : ι → Plane) (r : ℝ) : Set Plane :=
  {x | ∀ i, r^2 < squaredLength (x-z i)}
def closedRoundDisk (z : Plane) (r : ℝ) : Set Plane := {x | squaredLength (x-z) ≤ r^2}
